title: Patagonia offers $100 to customers who help others plan to vote
author: New York Times Service
bullets: Business The initiative begins Saturday.

John Tully/Getty Images By Kim Bhasin, New York Times Service September 22, 2026 | 11:04 AM 3 minutes to read Patagonia is offering customers a financial incentive to encourage friends and family to make a plan to vote in the midterm elections.

The outdoor apparel company said it would give up to 112,000 customers a $100 discount on Patagonia merchandise if they enroll three people in a program to encourage registered voters to cast a ballot in the midterms.

title: Federal Transit Authority ends its oversight of MBTA safety after 4 years
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Local News The oversight began after a man was dragged to death by a Red Line train in April 2022.

Trees and limbs have fallen across some portions of the line and crews are working to clear the debris.
